0022600201.text: The LA Clippers (1-7, 1-3 at home, on a seven-game losing streak and 13th in the West) host the New Orleans Pelicans (4-5, on a one-game losing streak and 11th in the West) in the Clippers' ninth game of the 2026-27 season. Currently out for the Clippers are Bradley Beal, Brandon Ingram, Isaiah Jackson, Jordan Miller and Yanic Konan Niederhauser, while Yves Missi is out for New Orleans. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the most recent meeting was a 105-99 Clippers loss in New Orleans on March 19, 2026, with no games yet between them in 2026-27.
